cryptohome: Fix chall-resp OAEP decoding failures Fix the incorrect construction of SecureBlob from a characters constant in the TPM 1.2 signature-sealing backend implementation. This CL makes sure that the SecureBlob is constructed from the intended 4-byte constant. Presumably, the old code was an undefined behavior due to creating a SecureBlob from a non-zero-terminated sequence of characters - i.e., effectively constructing std::string with reading some bytes beyond the global constant. For some reason, this bad code started to consistently fail starting from R77-12287.0.0 in official builders. As a consequence, broken from this point on the TPM 1.2 devices were the platform_CryptohomeTpmLiveTestServer Autotest, the hwsec.ChallengeResponseMount Tast test, and the actual challenge-response protected mount functionality (a.k.a. smart card based user login). It causes the audio thread will wake up immediately next time to read frames again from devices. With this change, the autio thread can read all frames it needs in the one wake up period. It can reduce lots of unnecessary operations. BUG=None TEST=Audio thread read samples correctly on panther.
